applicant.name: Dr. Test Applicant
applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Health, quality of care department

purpose: Guideline adherence in diabetes care for a quality programme.
question: Among patients with type 2 diabetes, how many have no active metformin, by hospital?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Metformin = ATC code starting with A10BA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: patients with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have no active metformin and that share in %, one decimal.
